name: keypaste CLI
summary: The vault, project environments and agent approvals from your terminal.

name: Agent approvals
summary: An AI agent asks for one field of one entry, and you decide each time.

name: Project environments
summary: A project's variables live in your vault and reach a program's environment, never a .env file.

name: Desktop app
summary: Your KeePass file in a simple app for Windows, macOS and Linux, with approvals and project runs under one unlock.

name: Share links
summary: One field or one login, sealed on your machine and opened a set number of times.

name: Scoped CI tokens
summary: A token that releases one project's environment to a CI job, with a scope and an expiry.

name: Daily driver
summary: Touch ID and Windows Hello, TOTP codes, browser fill, merging a synced file and importers.

name: Agents without values
summary: An agent calls an API with a credential it never holds.

name: Team projects
summary: A project's secrets shared with your team through a relay that stores only ciphertext.

name: CI and deploys
summary: Identities for CI jobs and deploy targets, and syncs pushed from your own machine.

name: Organizations
summary: Single sign-on, SCIM, approval for production changes and audit export.
